// Every locale's table, by locale: the compiler holds each to the English keys.
export const LOCALES: Record<Locale, Record<Key, string>> = {
  en: EN, ko: KO, ja: JA, zh: ZH, 'zh-TW': ZH_TW, es: ES, de: DE, fr: FR, pt: PT,
  ru: RU, hi: HI, id: ID,
}

export function t(locale: Locale, key: Key, vars: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  return LOCALES[locale][key].replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (whole, name: string) => vars[name] ?? whole)
}

{
  "name": "tidia",
  "displayName": "Tidia — dictation cleanup for Claude Code",
  "version": "0.1.28",
  "description": "Tidy dictation for AI: turns voice dictation in the Claude Code prompt into a clear, concise message before you send it, with fillers, repeats and taken-back words gone and several requests as a list; or, in minimal style, keeps your own wording.",
  "author": {
    "name": "JoungKyoungLyoo"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/fbwndrud/tidia",
  "repository": "https://github.com/fbwndrud/tidia",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "voice",
    "dictation",
    "mod",
    "prompt"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "style": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Style",
      "description": "polish: a clear, concise message for the AI; one point as plain sentences, several requests as a list, and your output rules (wording, register such as polite or casual, layout). minimal: plain sentences in your own words, only fillers and taken-back words removed; output rules are not applied.",
      "options": [
        "polish",
        "minimal"
      ],
      "default": "polish"
    },
    "english_terms": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "English terms",
      "description": "How far English and technical terms that speech recognition wrote phonetically go back to English spelling. auto: by the dictation's language (high for Korean, Japanese, Russian and other phonetic scripts, low for Chinese and for Latin-script languages other than English, off for English). off: never. low: code (useEffect, git push). medium: also product, company and language names (Claude, Python). high: also technical words (database, commit).",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off",
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Model",
      "description": "The model that cleans the dictated text. sonnet: most faithful (default). haiku: fastest and cheapest, may drop a request after a spoken correction. opus: most capable, slowest.",
      "options": [
        "sonnet",
        "haiku",
        "opus"
      ],
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "learn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Learn corrected words",
      "description": "ask: when you retype a dictated word the same way twice, add it to the dictionary. off: never learn.",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "dict_approval": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dictionary changes by Claude",
      "description": "auto: Claude adds a word you dictated that speech recognition got wrong (when the two sound alike), and removes entries it added, without asking; each change is shown. Changing or removing any other entry (yours, or one Tidia learned from your corrections) asks. ask: every dictionary change Claude makes asks you first.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "ask"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "polish_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "When to tidy",
      "description": "enter: tidy once, when you press Enter (fewest model calls; the send waits a few seconds; message_view sets how the message then shows). pause: tidy each time you stop speaking and show the result above the prompt, so you see what Enter sends; a model call per pause (often 2–4 per message), and the preview cannot be edited: change the prompt and it is sent as you changed it, untidied.",
      "options": [
        "enter",
        "pause"
      ],
      "default": "enter"
    },
    "message_view": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tidied message view",
      "description": "How a message tidied at Enter shows in the conversation, on the desktop and in the terminal. tidied: only the message sent. labeled: what Tidia did above it (→ tidied, → list, → minimal). full: what you said, then what Tidia did and the message sent.",
      "options": [
        "tidied",
        "labeled",
        "full"
      ],
      "default": "tidied"
    },
    "bubble_labels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Bubble words",
      "description": "The words for what Tidia did, shown with message_view labeled or full, in the order tidied/list/minimal, separated by /. A part left empty keeps the interface language's word. Up to 80 characters.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "debug": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show details",
      "description": "Show what Tidia does: the tidied preview, the rule and setting changes Claude made, and why a send went out untidied. Off: Tidia stays quiet, except for the dictionary changes Claude makes and Claude turning Tidia on or off, which always show.",
      "default": false
    },
    "dictionary": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use the dictionary",
      "description": "Send your dictionary entries and the conversation's file and identifier names to the cleanup as spelling hints, and learn words you correct. Off: tidy without them (your entries are kept).",
      "default": true
    },
    "attach_raw": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Attach the raw transcript",
      "description": "Send the raw dictation with each tidied message as one line Claude sees and your message row does not, so Claude can recover from a bad cleanup. The line holds a fixed sentence and the raw text only.",
      "default": true
    },
    "ui_language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Interface language",
      "description": "Language of the mod's labels: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Hindi or Indonesian. auto follows Claude Code's language setting; unsupported languages use English.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "ko",
        "ja",
        "zh",
        "zh-TW",
        "es",
        "de",
        "fr",
        "pt",
        "ru",
        "hi",
        "id"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
